Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CSIR CSMCRI Project Assistant II Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Project Assistant -II. This is a contractual position offered by CSIR CSMCRI.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Assistant -II post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc degree in Botany, Marine biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Oceanography, Microbiology, or Marine Science.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant -II post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant -II post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per CSIR norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 20000 Per Month, along with House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person.

faq.question: Q7. When and where is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 12-10-2026 at Central Salt & Marine Chemicals Research Institute, Mandapam, Tamil Nadu, 623519.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant -II post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant -II post will be based on an Interview.
